title: Man. Post. Cap. VII: PLAC forensically just and unjust impossible tip
pass_a_gloss: Could Adam at once be forensically just and unjust, conformed and not conformed to God's law, persevering and not persevering in justice? Could he avert and bend from God and still stay upright? Hold God a liar, envious, malevolent, and still keep love, faith, obedience—justice? Tip before GAR's penalties / dying-you-die deepen.
pass_b_english: Could he at the same time be forensically just and unjust? Could he at the same time be conformed to God's law and not conformed? persevere and not persevere in justice? Could he turn and bend himself away from God and yet remain upright? Hold God for a liar, envious, malevolent, &c., and yet conserve love, faith, obedience toward God—that is, justice?
source_text: Poteratne simul forensi ratione justus & injustus esse? Poteratne simul esse legi Dei conformis & non conformis? perseverare & non perseverare in justitia? Poteratne sese a Deo avertere & incurvare, & tamen rectus permanere? Deum habere pro mendaci, invido, malevolo &c., & tamen conservare amorem, fidem, obedientiam erga Deum, seu justitiam?
